premises.text: Aviation must reach net-zero by 2050 but current trends leave a multi-gigaton CO2 gap
premises.evidence_span: there's an urgent need to decarbonize aviation. At the Paris Agreement, in France, where we're based, in 2015, the entire industry agreed to meet net zero emissions by 2050. But if you see the trend of today's aviation market, you get three gigatons CO2 equivalent per year in 2050

premises.text: Hydrogen is preferred over batteries and SAF for balancing energy efficiency with aircraft range/speed/payload
premises.evidence_span: hydrogen in the middle has good enough energy efficiency and a good enough aircraft performance. That's why we are choosing hydrogen at Beyond Aero to develop our first aircraft

premises.text: Start with light aircraft then a hydrogen-electric business jet with comparable mission performance and no direct emissions
premises.evidence_span: we need to start from the light aircraft. That's why today I'm very excited to introduce you one. One is our business jet but fully electric thanks to hydrogen technology

premises.text: Scalable powertrain architecture (H2 tanks, fuel cell, air supply, batteries, dual motors) with aircraft integration and thermal management
premises.evidence_span: This is possible thanks to our scalable portion architecture. Basically, it's three times that hydrogen truck, but for an aircraft. So we supply H2 tanks, H2 fuel cell, air supply system, and some batteries, and two electric motors for this architecture

premises.text: Working with European airports to make hydrogen available for the jet
premises.evidence_span: an important part of Beyond Activity is to work with European airports for them to be ready for our jet. So 200 airports handle 80% of the traffic in Europe, and we're working with 50 of them to bring hydrogen for our aircraft

domains.name: Aviation net-zero gap and hydrogen choice

value.text: Electric hydrogen aviation that matches business-jet missions without direct emissions
value.evidence_span: we propose comparable performance without the direct emissions

secondary_value.text: Long-run scale to regional/commercial platforms and large CO2 reduction contribution
secondary_value.evidence_span: we'll scale this to regional and commercial platforms. At the end of the day, Beyond Aero has a possible CO2 reduction contribution possible of 350 megaton of CO2 equivalent

causal_links.evidence_span: we are convinced aviation will be electric. That's a solution to fill this gap
